description: Mailbox configuration reference. Use field examples to build a flat YAML or JSON config object; do not pass this reference tree to fromFile().
format: YAML (.yaml/.yml) is the recommended file format and is parsed with PHP's yaml_parse() function; JSON remains supported. fromArray() accepts an already parsed settings array.
credentialRule: Exactly one of password or passwordFromSecretName must be present and nonempty. Both, neither, and null credentials are rejected.

host.description: IMAP hostname without a URL scheme. Implicit TLS and certificate verification are always enabled.

username.description: Nonempty IMAP login name, independent of the optional From identity.

password.description: Literal nonempty password, used exactly as supplied. Specify exactly one of password or passwordFromSecretName. The file contains plaintext when using this option.

passwordFromSecretName.description: Load the password by this name: process environment first; only an unset variable falls back to /var/run/secrets/<name>. Empty values fail. Names start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens. One trailing LF or CRLF is removed from file contents. Mutually exclusive with password.

draftsFolder.description: Exact nonempty server folder name used for storing drafts.

trashFolder.description: Exact nonempty server trash folder name. Moving requires native IMAP MOVE and UIDPLUS.

incomingFolder.description: Exact nonempty folder used as the configured incoming mailbox.

sentFolder.description: Exact nonempty folder containing sent-message copies used by consumers such as mail automation.

junkFolder.description: Exact nonempty junk or spam folder name.

managedFolders.description: Application-owned folder aliases mapped to exact nonempty IMAP folder names. Aliases start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen. Every configured target is checked when MailClient is created; missing target folders are created before the client is returned. Use MailClient::managedFolder(alias) to resolve an alias. Unknown aliases fail before a move.

automationFlags.description: IMAP keywords used by mailbox automation for terminal processing states. Supported keys are processed, error and actionRequired. Individual values may be overridden; omitted keys keep their defaults. Values must be valid custom IMAP keywords.

from.description: Default author address, optionally with a display name. Null leaves the identity unspecified; an explicit message identity takes precedence.

signature.description: Nonempty Markdown signature applied by default to new messages, replies/reply-all and forwards. Explicit per-message signatures or message defaults can override or disable it.

mode.description: Automatic mode enables automatic Seen and source Answered/Forwarded flags. Manual mode requires explicit flag actions.
